ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce / Scattered Spider affiliate chain: RMM install (SimpleHelp / ScreenConnect / AnyDesk) followed by pre-encryption inhibit-recove
ucs.description: Hunts the post-helpdesk-vish playbook that DragonForce RaaS affiliates (notably the Scattered Spider cluster behind the 2025 M&S / Co-op / Harrods intrusions) used to pivot from a social-engineered password reset into ransomware: drop a legitimate remote-management agent, then within hours run vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit/wbadmin/wevtutil and `net stop` against SQL/Veeam/EDR services in preparation for the Conti/LockBit-derived locker.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("simplehelp.exe","Remote Access.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","AnyDesk.exe","AteraAgent.exe","Syncro.Service.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*SimpleHelpCustomerService*","*ScreenConnect.WindowsClient*","*AnyDesk_setup*","*AnyDesk* --install*","*atera_agent*")) by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process span=1m | rename Processes.* AS * | eval rmm_time=_time, rmm_proc=process_name, rmm_cmd=process | fields rmm_time dest user rmm_proc rmm_cmd | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND Processes.process="*cl *") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND (Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*Backup*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelAgent*" OR Processes.process="*CSAgent*" OR Processes.process="*SophosAgent*")) by _time Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* AS * | eval action_time=_time, dest_proc=process_name, dest_cmd=process] | where action_time>=rmm_time AND (action_time-rmm_time)<=14400 | eval delay_min=round((action_time-rmm_time)/60,1) | table rmm_time action_time delay_min dest user rmm_proc rmm_cmd dest_proc dest_cmd | sort - action_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 240;  // 4h cap from RMM install to first destructive command
let RMMInstalls = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("simplehelp.exe","remote access.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","anydesk.exe","ateraagent.exe","syncro.service.exe")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("SimpleHelpCustomerService","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient","AnyDesk_setup","AnyDesk --install","atera_agent")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project RMMTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RMMAccount = AccountName,
              RMMProc = FileName, RMMCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
     or (FileName =~ "net.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has "stop"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSSQL","SQLAgent","Veeam","Backup","VSS","SophosAgent","SentinelAgent","CSAgent","WinDefend"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner RMMInstalls on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (RMMTime .. RMMTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| project ChainStart = RMMTime, ActionTimestamp = Timestamp,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, RMMTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RMMProc, RMMCmd,
          DestructiveBinary = FileName, DestructiveCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by ActionTimestamp desc

ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1) AND (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE)) AND (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"wevtutil cl"* OR *"stop MSSQL"* OR *"stop Veeam"* OR *"stop SentinelAgent"* OR *"stop CSAgent"* OR *"stop SophosAgent"*)) AND -@User:*$

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|wevtutil|net)\.exe$/i
| regex("(delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|wevtutil\\s+cl|stop\\s+(MSSQL|Veeam|Backup|SentinelAgent|CSAgent|SophosAgent|WinDefend))", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | ImageFileName=/\\(simplehelp|screenconnect\.windowsclient|screenconnect\.clientservice|anydesk|ateraagent|syncro\.service)\.exe$/i OR regex("(SimpleHelpCustomerService|ScreenConnect\\.WindowsClient|AnyDesk_setup|AnyDesk\\s+--install|atera_agent)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
    | RmmTime := @timestamp
    | RmmCmd  := CommandLine
    | RmmProc := ImageFileName
  }, field=aid, include=[RmmTime, RmmProc, RmmCmd])
| DelayMin := (@timestamp - RmmTime) / 60000
| DelayMin >= 0 AND DelayMin <= 240
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, RmmProc, ImageFileName, CommandLine, DelayMin], function=count())
ucs.rationale: DragonForce RaaS does not write its own initial-access toolkit — affiliates (Scattered Spider / UNC3944 cluster in M&S, Co-op, Harrods 2025; the 'Yanluowang-style' helpdesk-vish playbook) re-use legitimate RMM agents to land. The fingerprint that distinguishes this actor from generic ransomware is the *short* delay between an RMM appearing on a workstation (often the helpdesk-coerced reset target)

ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce BYOVD EDR-killer (Terminator / AuKill / EDRSandBlast) — known-vulnerable driver dropped to user-writable path then service-loade
ucs.description: Hunts the bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver step DragonForce affiliates run immediately before deploying their LockBit-Black / Conti-leaked locker: drop a signed-but-vulnerable kernel driver (TrueSight, RentDrv2, Process Hacker, GMER, dbutil_2_3, mhyprot2, RTCore64 etc.) into a user-writable directory and then create / start a service for it via sc.exe or NtLoadDriver — the technique CrowdStrike attributes to DragonForce's 'Terminator / AuKill / EDRSandBlast'-style tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND Filesystem.file_name IN ("truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gmer64.sys","procexp152.sys","kprocesshacker.sys","mhyprot2.sys","rtcore64.sys","aswarpot.sys","wnbios.sys","aukill.sys","msio64.sys","echo_driver.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","viragt64.sys","amsdk.sys","viragt.sys") by _time Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | rename Filesystem.* AS * | search file_path IN ("*\\Users\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Public\\*") | eval drop_time=_time | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND Processes.process="*create*binPath*") OR (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND Processes.process="*start*") OR (Processes.process_name="fltMC.exe" AND Processes.process="*unload*") OR Processes.process IN ("*NtLoadDriver*","*ZwLoadDriver*") by _time Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user | rename Processes.* AS * | eval load_time=_time, load_proc=process_name, load_cmd=process] | where load_time>=drop_time AND (load_time-drop_time)<=1800 | eval delay_sec=load_time-drop_time | table drop_time load_time delay_sec dest user file_name file_path load_proc load_cmd | sort - drop_time
ucs.kql:
let KnownVulnDrivers = dynamic([
  "truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gmer64.sys","procexp152.sys",
  "kprocesshacker.sys","mhyprot2.sys","rtcore64.sys","aswarpot.sys",
  "wnbios.sys","aukill.sys","msio64.sys","echo_driver.sys",
  "dbutil_2_3.sys","viragt64.sys","amsdk.sys","viragt.sys"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName in~ (KnownVulnDrivers)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Public\")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverName = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              DropperProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropperCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "sc.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create","start") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("binPath","kernel","driver"))
     or (FileName =~ "fltMC.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "unload")
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("NtLoadDriver","ZwLoadDriver")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner DriverDrops on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (DropTime .. DropTime + 30m)
| project DropTime, LoadTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, DropTime),
          DeviceName, DriverName, DropPath,
          DropperProc, DropperCmd, DropperAccount,
          LoaderProc = FileName, LoaderCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          LoaderAccount = AccountName
| order by DropTime desc

     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\fltMC.exe" and CommandLine has "unload")
     or CommandLine has_any ("NtLoadDriver","ZwLoadDriver")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner DriverDrops on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (DropTime .. DropTime + 30m)
| project DropTime, LoadTime = TimeGenerated,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, DropTime),

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: DragonForce / Scattered Spider BYOVD - Known Vulnerable Driver Dropped to User-Writable Path
id: 6a8e7b21-3d4c-4e2f-9b27-7a3c2d8f1e5b
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a known vulnerable / EDR-killer driver (RentDrv2, TrueSight, ProcExp152, GMER, KProcessHacker, mhyprot2, RTCore64, dbutil_2_3 etc.) in a user-writable location by a typical loader binary - the signature of DragonForce RaaS affiliate Terminator/AuKill/EDRSandBlast tradecraft prior to LockBit-Black / Conti-derived locker deployment.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/dragonforce-ransomware-deep-dive/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/001/
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1068
  - detection.threat_hunting
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_driver:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\truesight.sys'
      - '\rentdrv2.sys'
      - '\gmer64.sys'
      - '\procexp152.sys'
      - '\kprocesshacker.sys'
      - '\mhyprot2.sys'
      - '\rtcore64.sys'
      - '\aswarpot.sys'
      - '\wnbios.sys'
      - '\aukill.sys'
      - '\dbutil_2_3.sys'
      - '\echo_driver.sys'
      - '\msio64.sys'
      - '\viragt64.sys'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Public\'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_driver and selection_path and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Vendor diagnostic utilities legitimately bundling a signed-but-vulnerable driver. Cross-check signer thumbprint and ImagePath against the approved-tool inventory.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11) AND @TargetFilename:(*\\truesight.sys OR *\\TrueSight.sys OR *\\TRUESIGHT.SYS OR *\\rentdrv2.sys OR *\\RentDrv2.sys OR *\\gmer64.sys OR *\\GMER64.sys OR *\\procexp152.sys OR *\\ProcExp152.sys OR *\\kprocesshacker.sys OR *\\KProcessHacker.sys OR *\\mhyprot2.sys OR *\\rtcore64.sys OR *\\RTCore64.sys OR *\\aswarpot.sys OR *\\wnbios.sys OR *\\aukill.sys OR *\\AuKill.sys OR *\\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\\echo_driver.sys OR *\\msio64.sys OR *\\viragt64.sys) AND @TargetFilename:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Public\\*) AND -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(truesight|rentdrv2|gmer64|procexp152|kprocesshacker|mhyprot2|rtcore64|aswarpot|wnbios|aukill|dbutil_2_3|echo_driver|msio64|viragt64|amsdk)\.sys$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|Temp|ProgramData|AppData|Public)\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(rundll32|powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|regsvr32|msiexec|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i OR regex("\\\\(Users|Temp|ProgramData|AppData|Public)\\\\", field=ContextImageFileName, flags="i")
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | (ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i AND regex("(create|start).*(binPath|kernel|driver)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
      OR (ImageFileName=/\\fltMC\.exe$/i AND regex("unload", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
      OR regex("(NtLoadDriver|ZwLoadDriver)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
    | LoadTime := @timestamp
    | LoaderCmd := CommandLine
  }, field=aid, include=[LoadTime, LoaderCmd])
| DelaySec := (LoadTime - @timestamp) / 1000
| DelaySec >= 0 AND DelaySec <= 1800
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, LoaderCmd, DelaySec], function=count())
ucs.rationale: DragonForce affiliates build on top of the leaked Conti and LockBit-Black source — the locker itself is generic, but the *prelude* is distinctive: deploy an EDR-killer (CrowdStrike-tracked names: 'Terminator' from Spyboy, 'AuKill', 'EDRSandBlast', 'Realblindingedr') that loads a signed-but-vulnerable third-party driver to NULL the kernel callbacks before launching the encryptor.
